next.reason: 1985: EXIT PROGRAM not under a calling program 'causes execution of the program to continue with the next executable statement'. 2023: it 'is treated as if it were a CONTINUE statement' (§2023:14.9.14.4 GR2), and 'EXIT PROGRAM causes an explicit transfer of control only when the statement is executed in a called program' (§2023:14.6.3). Same result; the RAISING phrase is new syntax.
